claims: Colby Covington defeated Dillon Danis by technical fall (14-4) in a freestyle wrestling match at RAF 7 on March 28, 2026, in Tampa, Florida.
Colby Covington dominated the second period.
Colby Covington called out Chris Weidman after the victory.
The match was the co-main event of RAF 7.
Yahoo Sports and Bloody Elbow noted that Covington controlled the second period with takedowns and mat exposure points after a competitive start (4-4).
The Colby Covington vs. Dillon Danis live blog noted that Danis expressed disappointment but left without incident, according to Yahoo Sports and MMA Fighting.
An Instagram post noted that the event was a specialized wrestling format rather than an MMA fight.
